definition: A crowdsourced platform where users compare responses from different anonymized language models in blind pairwise comparisons, used to compute Elo-style leaderboard rankings.
details: Chatbot Arena provides a large-scale, real-world human preference signal for ranking language models, complementing static academic benchmarks with a dynamic, crowdsourced evaluation approach.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Boil it down and it is this: A crowdsourced platform where users compare responses from different anonymized language models in blind pairwise comparisons, used to compute Elo-style leaderboard rankings. Here is why it matters: Chatbot Arena provides a large-scale, real-world human preference signal for ranking language models, complementing static academic benchmarks with a dynamic, crowdsourced evaluation approach. What gets measured is what actually gets better. That shared ruler is Chatbot Arena.

citation.title: Chatbot Arena: An Open Platform for Evaluating LLMs by Human Preference
